nodes.label: Ticketmaster replaces google_events (rationale)
nodes.rationale: SerpApi google_events stopped returning real results and Bing Events also didn't trigger a carousel on this account, so the sync now calls Ticketmaster Discovery API directly, while keeping the misleading function/file name syncSerpApiEventsToSanity because daemonServer.ts and telegramHttpServer.ts import it by that exact name.

nodes.label: Bright Data primary / SerpAPI fallback (rationale)
nodes.rationale: Bright Data is Stage 0's primary SERP provider; falls back to SerpAPI on error/timeout/empty/non-200 response.

nodes.label: Pipeline V2 Stage 0-9 Funnel
nodes.rationale: Chains Stage 0-2 discovery, Stage 9 dedupe (moved early to avoid wasted work), Stage 3 sourcing, Stage 4 sufficiency, Stage 5 writing, Stage 6 verification, Stage 7 imaging, and Stage 8 assembly/publish into one funnel; every module is deliberately decoupled (local type redefinitions, port-don't-import) except this orchestrator, whose whole job is real wiring.

nodes.label: Port, Don't Import Pattern
nodes.rationale: Each Stage 3-8 module redefines input/output shapes locally and copies helper logic (e.g. openAiJson, htmlToPlainText, factId, AZ_CITY_HINTS) from sibling modules instead of importing them, keeping every stage standalone/shadow-mode and decoupled from production files, at the cost of duplicated logic that must be kept in sync manually.
